description: SOX-aligned financial reporting platform on Azure with immutable audit trails, segregation of duties for deployment and data access, encryption with customer-managed keys, and change-management evidence linked to architecture reviews.
constraints: Segregation of duties between developers and production operators
Immutable audit log retention for seven years
Customer-managed keys for data at rest
No production data in non-production subscriptions
requiredCapabilities: Microsoft Entra ID PIM for privileged roles
Azure Policy deny assignments for public endpoints
Azure Monitor and Log Analytics with retention locks
assumptions: Annual SOX ITGC evidence exported from ArchLucid governance artifacts
All production changes require approved change ticket
